errors.evidence: The light gray line representing 'Durchschnittliches Brutto-Gebot Gewinner' is solid, not dashed ('gestrichelt').
For the light gray line, the value at an x-axis value of 0.3 is approximately 5.2 Eurocent/kWh, not 5.1.

errors.text_span: erreicht bei 0,4 Eurocent/kWh etwa 5,35 Eurocent/kWh, um danach bis 0,9 Eurocent/kWh auf etwa 5,38 Eurocent/kWh leicht anzusteigen
errors.evidence: For the light gray line, the value at an x-axis value of 0.4 is exactly 5.4 Eurocent/kWh, not ~5.35. After this point, the line remains constant at 5.4; it does not increase slightly to ~5.38.

In the description of the dark gray line ('Durchschnittliches Netto-Gebot Gewinner'), the line is described as stable until x=0.3. However, the plot shows it is stable only until x=0.2, after which it begins to decrease.

errors.text_span: fällt dann bei 0,4 Eurocent/kWh auf etwa 4,98 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: For the dark gray line, the value at x=0.4 is approximately 4.9 Eurocent/kWh, not 4.98.

errors.text_span: sinkt kontinuierlich weiter bis zu 4,45 Eurocent/kWh bei 0,9 Eurocent/kWh
errors.evidence: The final value of the dark gray line at x=0.9 is exactly 4.5 Eurocent/kWh, not 4.45.

In the description of the purple line ('Durchschnittliche Stromgestehungskosten Gewinner'), the line is described as stable until x=0.3. However, the plot shows it is stable only until x=0.2, after which it begins to increase.

errors.text_span: bleibt bis 0,9 Eurocent/kWh auf etwa 5,23 Eurocent/kWh konstant
errors.evidence: For the purple line, the constant value from x=0.4 to x=0.9 is approximately 5.27 Eurocent/kWh, not 5.23. The description also incorrectly implies the value drops from ~5.25 to ~5.23 instead of remaining constant.
